s3-lifecycle.heading: S3 lifecycle configuration does not stabilize

lambda-partial-batch.heading: Lambda partial batch response setting is discarded
lambda-partial-batch.effect: ignore this attribute in the repeat-plan assertion

tags-iam.heading: Resource tag readback is incomplete

tags-s3.heading: Resource tag readback is incomplete

tags-lambda-mapping.heading: Resource tag readback is incomplete
